name: Kaguya (SELENE)
fact: Japan's second lunar orbiter, launched in 2007. From a circular polar orbit at 100 km it mapped the Moon's shape, composition, gravity and magnetism, and its high-definition camera filmed Earth rising over the limb. The mission ended in 2009 with a controlled impact near Gill crater. Its terrain camera images serve as context maps for many of the landing sites in this app.
capability: A global terrain map, plus gravity measurements of the far side by Doppler tracking through the Okina relay satellite.
